title: Strategy and Robinhood now lead a $4.5 billion large-cap ETF that was not built for crypto
summary:

content: MicroStrategy and Robinhood have gained a combined weight of over six percent in a major large-cap ETF that was not originally designed for cryptocurrency exposure. This development highlights how crypto-linked market volatility can increasingly impact generalist stock portfolios and broad investment funds.

title: Iran has 30 million barrels of oil left for China, says Treasury Secretary Bessent
summary:

The post Iran has 30 million barrels of oil left for China, says Treasury Secretary Bessent appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: US Treasury Secretary Bessent stated that Iran has a limited supply of thirty million barrels of oil remaining for delivery to China. title: 7 Satoshi-Era Bitcoin (BTC) Miners Wake Up After 16.5 Years
summary: The market witnesses a substantial increase in selling pressure after Bitcoin came closer to $80,000.
content: Seven Satoshi-era Bitcoin miners have suddenly become active after remaining dormant for 16.5 years. This unexpected reactivation coincides with the cryptocurrency market experiencing a substantial increase in selling pressure as Bitcoin's price approaches the significant milestone of $80,000, drawing close attention from market observers tracking early coin movements.

title: President Trump Pledges Up to $500,000,000 from Super PAC for Midterms
summary:
President Donald Trump said his super PAC MAGA Inc. will allocate $400-500 million to help Republican candidates in the November midterms, claiming close to a billion dollars available.
The post President Trump Pledges Up to $500,000,000 from Super PAC for Midterms appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: President Donald Trump announced that his super PAC, MAGA Inc., plans to allocate between $400 million and $500 million to support Republican candidates in the upcoming November midterms. During the announcement, Trump stated that the organization has close to a billion dollars available for these political efforts, aiming to heavily influence the midterm elections.

title: OPEC+ set to maintain oil output policy unchanged at Sunday meeting
summary:
OPEC+'s unchanged policy stabilizes short-term oil supply, but 2027's quota decisions could disrupt markets amid geopolitical tensions.
The post OPEC+ set to maintain oil output policy unchanged at Sunday meeting appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: OPEC+ is expected to keep its current oil output policy unchanged during its upcoming Sunday meeting. While this decision provides stability for short-term oil supplies, upcoming quota decisions in later years could create disruptions in global markets, particularly as geopolitical tensions continue to affect the energy sector.

title: Aivres acquires US AI chips despite parent company’s blacklisting
summary:
Aivres' operations highlight loopholes in US export controls, potentially undermining efforts to restrict sensitive tech access globally.
The post Aivres acquires US AI chips despite parent company’s blacklisting appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Aivres has successfully acquired US artificial intelligence chips despite its parent company facing blacklisting. This situation exposes significant loopholes within existing US export controls, raising concerns that current regulations may fail to effectively restrict global access to sensitive technology. Observers note this development could undermine ongoing efforts to regulate high-tech hardware distribution.

title: Tether-backed Orionx to shut down after audit flags $7M custody gap
summary:
The closure of Orionx highlights the critical need for stringent regulatory oversight and robust internal controls in the crypto industry.
The post Orionx shuts down after audit reveals $7M custody gap appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Crypto platform Orionx, which is backed by Tether, has announced it will shut down operations. The decision follows an audit that uncovered a significant custody gap of approximately seven million dollars. This closure underscores growing concerns regarding internal financial controls and regulatory oversight within the digital asset industry as companies face increasing scrutiny over asset management and security practices.
